build_vul_graphs_from_assembly: build graphs from x86 assembly files using Graphs_build_x86 and load them into a dataset
build_vocab_from_assembly_graphs: build a vocabulary from assembly graph nodes with frequency filtering and minimum threshold
preprocess_assembly_dataset: preprocess assembly graphs into DGL-compatible node and edge arrays using a vocabulary mapping
load_graphs_from_csv: load assembly graphs from a CSV file mapping commit IDs to targets and assembly paths
run_vul_preprocessing_pipeline: run the full vulnerability preprocessing pipeline to generate vocab, dataset, and target pickle files
